description:
Your cheat code for fun.

26" or 27.5" Frames

Two frames to choose from: Choose the 26" for the utmost in nimble flickability on dirt jumps, or the 801 27.5" for extra stability and versatility on pump tracks and dual slalom courses. (It’s still no slouch while jumping!)

Evolved Geometry

Quickly learn new skills and develop a deeper sense of bike control with geometry that supports your progression. The 801 26" hits a sweet spot for tackling dirt jump lines. The 801 27.5" helps riders feel locked in on pump tracks or dual slalom courses.

Strength and Durability

Robust aluminum frame built to take a beating. The 801 is constructed of 6061-T6 aluminum alloy for high strength in a lightweight, robust package. We tested the frame to the same impact standards as our Superior Peak DH bike that has survived RedBull Rampage. Ride confidently.

Derailleur Compatible

801 27.5" comes with a derailleur hanger and cable routing for a drivetrain. Drivetrain capability provides gear optimization and the ability to shift to an easier gear for climbing back to the start of a dirt jump line or to a harder gear before you drop in.
